questions.question: To what does the psalmist compare his longing for God?
options: A small bird seeking out its own nest
A deer panting for flowing streams
A young child seeking a parent
questions.answer: A deer panting for flowing streams

questions.question: What question does the psalmist ask his own soul?
options: How long, O LORD, will you forget me?
Who shall ascend the hill of the LORD?
What shall I render to the LORD?
Why are you cast down, O my soul?
questions.answer: Why are you cast down, O my soul?

questions.question: The psalm is attributed to the Sons of Korah.
My soul thirsts for God, for the _____ God.
Hope in God; for I shall again _____ him, my salvation.
